jobs.title: Associate Director, Marketing Science
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Director, Marketing Science based in Canada.

As an Associate Director, Marketing Science, you will lead the measurement strategy that helps major B2B clients understand how their marketing investments contribute to pipeline and revenue. Combining hands-on statistical modeling with strategic consulting, you will build marketing mix models, design incrementality experiments, and translate complex data into actionable budget recommendations. You will take ownership of measurement across a portfolio of enterprise accounts, ensuring that every insight is transparent, reliable, and grounded in evidence. Working closely with data, machine learning, engineering, and client-facing teams, you will help turn advanced measurement methods into scalable solutions. This role offers the opportunity to shape a growing marketing science practice while influencing important commercial decisions for leading B2B organizations.

Accountabilities

You will own the end-to-end marketing measurement process for major client accounts, from assessing data quality and building analytical models to presenting findings and guiding investment decisions. You will combine technical execution, client communication, and cross-functional collaboration to establish measurement practices that continuously improve over time.

Assess client CRM, tracking, and marketing data to determine what can be measured immediately, what requires further development, and which data issues must be addressed first.
Define the most meaningful business outcomes for each model, selecting measurable funnel stages with sufficient and consistent volume in collaboration with client operations teams.
Direct tracking and CRM implementation improvements, including conversion tracking, UTM and click ID capture, lead source fields, lifecycle stage definitions, and system integrations.
Validate implementation changes and ensure data quality before incorporating information into measurement models.
Manage inconsistencies in historical data, including changes in definitions, broken tracking, and missing or undated events.
Build and continuously refine Bayesian marketing mix models using tools such as Google Meridian, including prior selection, calibration, diagnostics, and back-testing.
Translate model outputs into practical budget allocation scenarios, accounting for diminishing returns and channel constraints.
Design and manage quarterly incrementality experiments suited to B2B environments, including target-account holdouts, geographic splits, budget increases, and platform lift studies.
Conduct power analysis, establish break-even thresholds, and agree on decision rules before experiments begin.
Evaluate experiment results objectively, including inconclusive findings, and use them to improve model accuracy and narrow forecast ranges over time.
Collaborate with data, machine learning, and platform engineers to integrate measurement methodologies into client-facing products and workflows.
Use AI tools and agents to improve analytical efficiency while independently validating outputs and protecting client information.
Develop and present monthly Revenue Narratives with account directors, explaining performance, model findings, and recommended investment decisions in language accessible to marketing leaders and finance executives.
Present quarterly experiment findings and coordinate future testing roadmaps with channel teams.
Clearly communicate the limitations of available data and models, avoiding unsupported conclusions or misleading claims.
Document analytical decisions, assumptions, and trade-offs while maintaining rigorous quality standards for all client-facing deliverables.
Support new business and account expansion by explaining measurement capabilities and helping account and channel teams apply marketing science effectively.

Requirements

You bring substantial experience in marketing science, analytics, or data science, with a proven ability to turn sophisticated measurement into business decisions. You are comfortable building models independently, working with complex B2B data, and communicating analytical findings to senior stakeholders. You combine strong technical expertise with sound judgment, curiosity, and the ability to manage several client engagements simultaneously.

Significant professional experience in marketing science, analytics, or data science within an agency, consultancy, or growth-focused organization.
Demonstrated ownership of measurement initiatives that have directly influenced marketing budgets or business decisions.
Hands-on experience building and maintaining marketing mix models using Google Meridian, Robyn, PyMC-Marketing, or comparable frameworks.
Practical experience designing, analyzing, and interpreting incrementality experiments, including statistical power analysis and predefined decision criteria.
Experience measuring B2B marketing outcomes using CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot, particularly in environments with long sales cycles and low weekly conversion volumes.
Experience directing tracking and CRM implementation projects and ensuring the reliability of marketing data.
Some experience mentoring colleagues, managing a small team, or directing specialist contributors.
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience working with weekly data from advertising platforms, CRM systems, and web analytics tools.
Familiarity with data and cloud infrastructure such as BigQuery, dbt, Amazon SageMaker, or Google Vertex AI is an advantage.
Working knowledge of web tracking and CRM technologies, including Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, server-side tracking, Salesforce, and HubSpot.
An AI-forward mindset, with regular use of AI tools and agents, the ability to independently assess their outputs, and an interest in identifying new applications for these technologies.
Ability to transform complex datasets into clear deliverables that influence client or executive decisions.
Strong understanding of full-funnel performance and marketing investment across channels, rather than focusing on isolated campaign metrics.
Excellent storytelling and communication skills, including the confidence to explain when available evidence cannot support a requested conclusion.
Strong analytical judgment, curiosity, and the ability to challenge assumptions constructively.
Excellent organizational skills and the ability to oversee measurement activities across multiple client accounts.

Benefits

Annual base salary ranging from CAD 110,000 to CAD 140,000, with potential eligibility for a bonus. Actual compensation depends on relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.
Fully remote working arrangement from a home office in Canada.
Medical, dental, and vision insurance, along with disability and life insurance coverage for employees and their families.
Employer-paid insurance coverage for employees, with a 50% employer contribution toward dependent coverage.
Access to certified therapists through Spring Health and a Headspace membership.
Physical well-being resources, including physical therapy through Omada and virtual workouts through Aaptiv.
Complimentary One Medical membership for primary and virtual care.
Unlimited paid time off, with a two-week minimum, in addition to paid company holidays.
Birthday leave and an end-of-year company recharge period from December 24 to January 1.
Paid parental leave.
Traditional and Roth 401(k) retirement plans with a 3% company match.
Annual bonus opportunities that increase over time based on tenure.
Annual company-wide retreat.
A remote-first and inclusive work environment that supports professional development, collaboration, and individual well-being.
Reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and during employment for qualified individuals with disabilities.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
